biography: Xandinho Negrão, a name whispered with promise in the Brazilian karting scene, hails from a family steeped in motorsport passion. Born and raised in São Paulo, his grandfather, a former rally driver, gifted him a miniature kart at the tender age of five. While other children played football, Xandinho was tearing around his family's sprawling estate, mastering the nuances of grip and throttle control. His raw talent was undeniable. By age 10, he was competing nationally, frequently battling against older, more experienced drivers. A defining moment came at the 2018 Brazilian Karting Championship when, after a mechanical failure in qualifying that placed him at the back of the grid, he fought his way to a podium finish, showcasing his exceptional overtaking ability. Now at 21, Xandinho is making waves in the Kart 4 series, steadily building a reputation for consistency and a cool head under pressure. He dreams of Formula racing, but is methodical in his approach to progress.
drivingStyle: Xandinho possesses a remarkably smooth and calculated driving style. He isn't one for flamboyant overtakes or risky maneuvers. Instead, he focuses on maximizing corner speed by hitting precise apexes and maintaining momentum. He's known for his exceptional tire management skills, conserving rubber throughout a race to unleash a late-stage attack. Under pressure, Xandinho remains calm and composed, rarely making mistakes. He prefers a consistent pace, gradually building his advantage over the course of a race, rather than relying on outright speed.

famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed; it's about making the right calculations and executing them perfectly."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2019 São Paulo Karting Cup after a nail-biting final lap where he overtook two drivers in the last corner.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the 2020 Brazilian Karting Championship final due to a sudden downpour, costing him a potential championship victory.
